test: cannot change aware_at
sql: UPDATE incident SET aware_at = aware_at - INTERVAL 1 HOUR WHERE incident_id = 1
message: timestamps, reporter and kind are write-once; record an amendment instead

test: cannot report with aware_at in the future
sql: INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 1 DAY,UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 1 DAY,'LOW','NONE')
message: aware_at cannot be in the future

test: cannot skip workflow steps
sql: UPDATE incident SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE incident_id = 2
message: illegal status transition

test: cannot change a closed incident
sql: UPDATE incident SET title = 'x' WHERE incident_id = 3
message: a closed incident cannot change; open a linked incident instead

test: cannot add a harm to a closed incident
sql: INSERT INTO harm (incident_id,category,description,personal_data,recorded_by) VALUES (3,'OTHER','x','NO',1)
message: the incident is closed

test: cannot change severity without an amendment
sql: UPDATE incident SET severity = 'LOW' WHERE incident_id = 1
message: changing severity needs an amendment with a reason

test: cannot delete an incident (no DELETE permission)
sql: DELETE FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'incident'

test: cannot delete audit events
sql: DELETE FROM audit_event
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'audit_event'

test: cannot edit audit events
sql: UPDATE audit_event SET details = 'nothing happened'
message: UPDATE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'audit_event'

test: cannot create a user (no INSERT on app_user)
sql: INSERT INTO app_user (username,full_name,role,password_hash,salt) VALUES ('evil','E','REVIEWER',REPEAT('a',64),REPEAT('b',32))
message: INSERT command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'app_user'

test: cannot drop the triggers
sql: DROP TRIGGER trg_clock_bu
message: TRIGGER command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'obligation_clock'

test: cannot move a clock's deadline
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET due_at = due_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY WHERE clock_id = 2
message: a clock cannot be moved or reset

test: cannot start a clock with a made-up deadline
sql: INSERT INTO obligation_clock (incident_id, rule_id, started_at, due_at) SELECT incident_id, 1, aware_at, aware_at + INTERVAL 30 DAY FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: due_at does not match the rule window

test: cannot start a DPDP clock before Rule 7 is in force
sql: INSERT INTO obligation_clock (incident_id, rule_id, started_at, due_at) SELECT incident_id, 4, aware_at, aware_at + INTERVAL 4320 MINUTE FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 2
message: that rule was not in force when the organisation became aware

test: cannot mark a clock met without a sent notice
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='MET', met_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE clock_id = 2
message: a clock is met only by a sent notice

test: cannot reopen a met clock
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='RUNNING', met_at=NULL WHERE clock_id = 4
message: a clock that is MET or RULED_OUT is final

test: reporter cannot rule out their own incident's clock
sql: UPDATE obligation_clock SET status='RULED_OUT', ruled_out_by=1, ruled_out_reason='this one is not needed at all', ruled_out_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE clock_id = 2
message: the reporter of an incident cannot rule out its clocks

test: cannot insert a notice that is already approved
sql: INSERT INTO notification (clock_id,recipient,body,drafted_by,approved_by) VALUES (2,'CERT-In','x',1,2)
message: a new notice must be a draft

test: a reporter cannot approve a notice
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_by = 1 WHERE notification_id = 1
message: only a reviewer can approve a notice

test: a reviewer cannot approve a notice they drafted (CHECK constraint)
sql: UPDATE notification SET approved_by = 2 WHERE drafted_by = 2 AND approved_by IS NULL
message: Check constraint 'ck_notice_four_eyes' is violated.

test: cannot insert a mapping as already CONFIRMED
sql: INSERT INTO incident_mapping (incident_id,node_id,state,rationale,confidence,mapped_by,reviewed_by) VALUES (2,1,'CONFIRMED','looks right to me honestly','LOW',1,2)
message: a new mapping must be SUGGESTED

test: cannot extend a CERT-In clock
sql: INSERT INTO clock_extension (clock_id,new_due_at,board_reference,reason,recorded_by) VALUES (1, UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 1 DAY, 'REF-1', 'we would like more time please', 2)
message: this rule does not allow extensions

test: cannot report a late 'aware' without a reason (CHECK)
sql: INSERT INTO incident (kind,title,description,ai_system_id,reported_by,occurred_at,detected_at,aware_at,severity,adversary) VALUES ('AGENT','t','d',1,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 5 HOUR,UTC_TIMESTAMP()-INTERVAL 5 HOUR,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'LOW','NONE')
message: Check constraint 'ck_aware_gap' is violated.

test: cannot change which incident a report follows up
sql: UPDATE incident SET linked_to = 1 WHERE incident_id = 2
message: timestamps, reporter and kind are write-once; record an amendment instead

test: cannot erase or edit sign-in history
sql: DELETE FROM login_attempt
message: DELETE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'login_attempt'

test: cannot erase or edit sign-in history
sql: UPDATE login_attempt SET success = TRUE
message: UPDATE command denied to user 'pathivu_app'@'localhost' for table 'login_attempt'

test: cannot add an audit event with a forged hash
sql: INSERT INTO audit_event (incident_id,actor_id,action,details,created_at,prev_hash,hash) VALUES (NULL,1,'X','forged',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),@head,REPEAT('f',64))
message: audit hash does not match its contents

test: cannot add an audit event that branches off an old point
sql: INSERT INTO audit_event (incident_id,actor_id,action,details,created_at,prev_hash,hash) VALUES (NULL,1,'X','fork',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),REPEAT('0',64),REPEAT('e',64))
message: audit event does not extend the chain head
